name: Starknet Bridge

repos.scope: Indexes StarkNet StarkGate L1 bridge: StarknetMessaging contract (LogMessageToL2/ConsumedMessageToL2) plus token bridge deposit/withdrawal events. Templated multi-bridge config.
repos.verified: Cloned repo; subgraph.template.yaml has StarknetMessaging dataSource with bridge event handlers; schema.graphql defines DepositEvent/withdrawal entities; config.template.ts lists L1/L2 bridge addresses. 7 commits, community, no recent activity.

notes: Community subgraph (kaonone). Also enviodev/starknet-bridge-indexer exists but is a 1-commit blank Envio scaffold (not verified as indexing). No official StarkWare subgraph.

name: Marinade Native
notes: Solana-only liquid/native staking. marinade-finance org has on-chain program + TS SDK/CLI repos but no public EVM-style subgraph/indexer. Solana programs are not subgraph-indexable.

name: ether.fi Liquid
notes: ether.fi docs reference a deployed subgraph for Liquid vaults but no public subgraph/indexer source repo found in etherfi-protocol org (only smart-contracts, cross-chain, DefiLlama-Adapters). Liquid vaults use Veda/BoringVault framework.

name: Marinade Liquid Staking
notes: Solana-only (mSOL). No public EVM-style subgraph/indexer; org has Anchor program + SDK only.

name: Huma Finance V2
notes: 00labs org has huma-contracts/huma-contracts-v2, huma-monorepo (git-submodule based), huma-js SDK. SDK/docs reference a hosted subgraph for receivables/pools, but no public subgraph/indexer source repo located.

name: VALR
notes: Centralized exchange; no public onchain indexer/subgraph.

name: GMX V2 Perps

repos.scope: Official GMX monorepo of subgraphs; includes 'synthetics-stats' subgraph for GMX V2 (synthetics) perps on Arbitrum & Avalanche, plus prices/raw/stats subgraphs.
repos.verified: WebFetch of repo listing confirms synthetics-stats directory (GMX V2) alongside gmx-arbitrum/avalanche stats; 362 commits; official gmx-io org. V2 endpoints served via satsuma.

notes: Official. synthetics-stats = GMX V2 perps subgraph.

name: Aerodrome Slipstream

repos.scope: Official Envio multi-chain indexer for Velodrome V2 (Optimism) and Aerodrome (Base, chain 8453), including Slipstream concentrated-liquidity pools via CLFactory/CLPool event handlers.
repos.verified: Cloned repo; config.yaml description states 'Multi-chain indexer for Velodrome V2 on Optimism and Aerodrome on Base' with chain id 8453; src/EventHandlers/CLFactory.ts & CLPool.ts handle Slipstream CL pools. Pushed Jun 2026.

notes: Official Envio (HyperIndex) indexer shared by Velodrome/Aerodrome. type marked ponder as closest enum (it is Envio/custom TS indexer). velodrome-finance/subgraph is archived (2023) and Velodrome-only.

name: Yearn Finance

repos.scope: Official real-time/historical EVM indexer with built-in index over Yearn V2 and V3 vault ecosystems (registries, vaults, strategies, accountants, debt allocators). TS + Postgres/Timescale + GraphQL.
repos.verified: WebFetch confirms Kong 'comes configured with an index over Yearn Finance v2 and v3 vault ecosystems'; 376 commits; recommended by Yearn docs over subgraphs.

repos.scope: Official V2 vault subgraph (Ethereum, Fantom, Arbitrum).
repos.verified: WebFetch: described as official V2 subgraph; archived by owner Nov 6, 2025.

notes: Official. Kong is the current actively-maintained indexer (V2+V3); the older V2 subgraph is archived.
